rules: Use Chivo for all headings (H1-H4). Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, Lato, or Space Grotesk.
Use JetBrains Mono for all body text, metrics, numbers, and data points to emphasize the developer/terminal feel.
Headings should use tracking-tight. Data points should use tracking-tighter.
Expose the skeleton. Use 1px subtle borders (border-border) on cards.
No rounded corners on major panels (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) to keep the brutalist/technical aesthetic.
No soft shadows. Use sharp inner contrasts or flat surfaces.
Include scanlines or subtle grid backgrounds for the terminal look.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.

layouts.container: h-screen w-full flex overflow-hidden bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white font-mono
structure: Sidebar (col-span-3 or fixed width): Session List / Resume. Shows active and past sessions.
Main Content (flex-1 or col-span-9): Scrollable dashboard area.
Dashboard Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-6
Widgets span logic: Metrics (Cost, Turns, Timeline) take 3-4 cols each. Context Gauge takes 4 cols, Token Breakdown takes 8 cols.

customizations: Cards: Cardless or sharp borders. Remove shadows. Use bg-[#111111] and border-[#222222].
Badges: Use sharp borders and high contrast colors matching the alert states.
Progress: Flat, sharp corners. Use specific accent colors for thresholds (green/yellow/red).

rules: Minimalist animations. Use micro-interactions for feedback on hover.
Do NOT use 'transition-all'. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors).
Data updates should have slight number-ticker animations if possible, or just fade in.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
Focus states must have a 2px outline using the info accent color.

icons.usage: Use for dense dashboard and developer tools. Use 'weight="duotone"' or 'weight="regular"'.

rules: Use Recharts for Context Fullness Gauge (RadialBarChart or PieChart) and Token Usage Breakdown (Stacked BarChart or custom Progress bars).
Use stark, high-contrast colors for charts (e.g., cyan for input, purple for reasoning, gray for cached, blue for output).
Keep charts flat and sharp. No drop shadows on chart elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React application for the AI Context Awareness Tracker using the provided layout and styling rules.
Implement the Sidebar for the 'Session List' and the Main Content area for the active session dashboard.
Create placeholder/mock data for the dashboard state (Token budgets, time awareness, context health, model info, cost, turns).
Build a Context Fullness Gauge using Recharts or a custom SVG/Shadcn Progress component.
Build a Token Usage Breakdown showing input/output/cached/reasoning breakdown.
Implement the Alert Threshold States (warn/danger/red-alert) as prominent badges or a dedicated status panel.
Ensure all components use `data-testid` (e.g., data-testid='context-gauge', data-testid='session-item-1').
Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric data and Chivo for widget headers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use Phosphor icons. Do not use AI emojis.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Follow the theme and color archetypes strictly.
